author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: With the Fed heading for a March lift-off into 40-year-high inflation and Russia-Ukraine risk peaking into the Munich Security Conference weekend, markets are paying for certainty: pricing power and cash returns (Walmart, Cisco), energy, staples and gold are rewarded, while long-duration growth that admits any normalisation or higher spending (Shopify, Roblox, Palantir, Nvidia) is sold even as five-observation Treasury yields fall on haven demand; stay defensive with real-asset hedges, keep growth and crypto light, and let the VIX versus its 20-session-earlier 25.59 and the 2Y at 1.49% decide when to re-risk.
sources_policy: Evidence limited to the 2022-02-18 frozen feed (tools/digest.py, feeds/2022-02-18.json.gz) and the 2022-02-18 market card (tools/showcard.py, cards/2022-02-18.json); no other date's feed, card, spec, draft or note, and no specs/, retail_drafts/, notes/retail_* or audit/independent_* files were read. Every number is a card field or appears in a headline cited in the same part; all 241 card values quoted were cross-checked programmatically against cards/2022-02-18.json (instrument, field, session 2022-02-17). Treasury figures use the card's curve wording (positively sloped; bear flattening (both up, 2Y up more)). No numeric spot-FX; currency direction only from dated headlines (dollar n0114, yuan n0244, zloty n1738); DXY quoted as an index. Crypto uses the prior completed UTC daily close 2022-02-17. Each citation is used at most twice in the nonretail component (229 distinct IDs) to leave room under the merged cap of four. Previews (Barron's on Deere n0150, the MSC eve page n0153, Reuters on MSC n0119, Reuters poll on March hike size n1376) are used only to establish pending events. Exclusions file for 2022-02-18 is empty; none of the items listed below is cited.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n2164 Reuters 'France unemployment hits 13-year low' (stamped 2022-02-17): INSEE's Q4 unemployment release appears to fall on the morning of 2022-02-18, after the cutoff; day-granular stamp - omitted as possibly after-cutoff.

n0919 Bloomberg 'Kering Shares Surge as Gucci Sales Rebound' and n0917 CNBC 'Kering CEO shares plans for M&A activity': Kering reported after the Paris close on 2022-02-17, so the share reaction and CEO interview likely belong to 2022-02-18 trading - omitted as after-cutoff; n0918/n0920 Kering results items also left out for consistency.

n0156 Reuters 'Ukraine crisis takes centre stage at Munich Security Conference' and n0157 NPR 'Vice President Harris is meeting leaders in Munich': the conference runs 18-20 February and these may describe proceedings after the cutoff - omitted; only unambiguous previews (n0119, n0153) used.
n1445 CNN 'Photos: Russia invades Ukraine' (stamped 2022-02-14): misdated; no invasion has occurred at the cutoff - excluded.
n1427 NPR 'Russia's at war with Ukraine. Here's how we got here': ambiguous framing (Donbas conflict versus invasion) - excluded to avoid implying a war outcome.

n0901 Reuters 'Goldman Sachs lifts targets in bid to win over skeptics' and n0902 FT 'Goldman Sachs: new financial targets, same existential angst': contradicted by the 2022-02-16 Reuters preview n0749 that Goldman was still to refresh targets; possible misdate or after-cutoff event - all three omitted.
n1089 WSJ 'Evergrande CEO Sold Bonds Before Profit Warning' (2022-02-10, labelled result): company news outside the seven-day window despite the category label - omitted.
n1060 Gadgets 360 'Bitcoin, Ether Prices See Little Price Movement': contradicts the completed 2022-02-17 daily close (BTC -7.79%) - omitted as contradictory.
n1292 Euronews 'German manufacturing slumps in October as new orders drop - PMI' (stamped 2022-02-11): stale/misdated - omitted.

Live blogs and rolling pages omitted: n1360, n1325 and n1314 (Reuters LIVE MARKETS, including the 'PPI pop' item), n0151 and n0115 (Yahoo 'Earnings Calendar for:'), n2235 (Reuters rolling factbox of bank Fed forecasts).
n1683 Newsweek Polska item alleging missing NBP files on a Russian bank and possible involvement of the governor: unverified allegation - omitted.

Promotional, irrelevant or misdated listings omitted: n0981 and n0829 (Fortune Business Insights '2034' reports), n0534 and n0408 ('2026' stock lists), n1179 (ESPN 2026), n1057 (altcoins to buy), n0844 and n0837 (stock-picking lists), n1214 (IPO Edge promotion), n0979 (Seeking Alpha short thesis on Zynex).
Spot-FX: no numeric =X quotes or returns used; DXY is the only quoted currency gauge.

Guardrail-known events without own-date headline support were not mentioned: Blinken's UN address, Australia's January jobs report and Japan's January CPI (no own-date headline), and US January retail sales; the Australian jobless reference (n0004) is the earlier December print and is not described as the latest. Pending UK retail sales (18 February 07:00 UTC) has no own-date preview and is not dated in the text.

Timing dispositions for items used: Roku (n0949) reported after the US close on 2022-02-17, before the cutoff; Chipotle's price-hike plan (n1095, stamped 2022-02-11) is tied to its results and is treated under the fourteen-day results window; Celanese/DuPont (n0868) is cited only as 'nearing a deal' per the Bloomberg-sourced headline, not as an announcement; Australian session closes (ASX, CSL, Fortescue) are described as preceding the US sell-off.
DWAC/Truth Social (n1870, n1890) and other social-attention items were left to the separate retail section.
authoring_stage: initial nonretail draft before independent review
